of.needed: whether nodes run Linux kernel 6.6 or newer and host third-party old-style tc BPF users

consequence.statement: On kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium switches from old-style tc BPF attachment to tcx BPF links by default, which may affect setups that have third-party old-style tc BPF users.
consequence.remediation: If third-party old-style tc BPF users are present, set bpf.enableTCX=false via Helm to keep the old-style tc BPF attachment mode.

assertion.statement: On Linux kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium 1.16 by default attaches its core-datapath tc BPF programs with tcx BPF links; setups with third-party old-style tc BPF users should set the Helm value bpf.enableTCX=false to keep the old tc attachment mode.
